name: Prishella III
description: Prishella III was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Kessel sector. It hosted several garrisons of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, a Rebel Alliance Special Forces team was air-dropped on Prishella III, where it kidnapped Imperial General Evar Orllincus during his inspection tour of the garrisons.
